ask.disclaimer: AI-generated astrological guidance for reflection and entertainment only — not a substitute for professional medical, financial, legal, or psychological advice. Verify important decisions independently.
ask.modalIntroWithData: This is the exact structured context the backend assembled and sent to the AI model:
ask.modalIntroNoData: This is the chart information that will be sent to the AI model. The backend also adds your full running dasha chain, yogas, doshas, current transits, Sarva Ashtakavarga and Shadbala — visible here after you ask a question:
ask.noteBody: The AI model receives this structured data along with your question: your Lagna, planetary positions and nakshatras, the currently-active Vimsottari dasha chain (Maha → Bhukti → Antara → Sookshma), yogas and doshas present in the chart, current planetary transits (Gochara), Sarva Ashtakavarga and Shadbala strengths.
ask.keysIntro: Keys are stored encrypted on the server and used only for your own requests. They're never shown back in full. Ollama (local) needs no key.
ask.enterNewKey: Enter a new key to replace
ask.snapshotNote: Full chart snapshot is only kept for answers generated in this session. Re-ask to see the complete data sent.
